title: The Fall of the Theorem Economy
summary: An essay by mathematician David Bessis exploring the changing economic landscape of mathematical research and theorem production, likely examining how the value and dissemination of mathematical knowledge is shifting in contemporary academia.
problem_solved: Examines the declining relevance or transformation of the traditional academic economy surrounding mathematical theorems and proofs.
why_valuable: Offers critical perspective on how mathematical knowledge production is being reshaped by modern academic and economic forces.
